name: head
summary: Emit the standard <head> contents for a view: meta tags, title, design token CSS, Datastar, and the ship-elements bundle. In fragment mode (loaded inside the shell via Datastar) these assets are already present, so the macro emits nothing.
description:
Emit the standard <head> contents for a view: meta tags, title, design
token CSS, Datastar, and the ship-elements bundle. In fragment mode
(loaded inside the shell via Datastar) these assets are already present,
so the macro emits nothing.

args.name: title
args.description: Document title. Shown in the browser tab. Defaults to 'Ship View'.

name: signal
summary: Declare a reactive Datastar signal on the current element. String defaults are emitted wrapped in single quotes, `none` becomes literal `null`, and other types pass through unquoted so objects/arrays/numbers/booleans serialize correctly.
description:
Declare a reactive Datastar signal on the current element. String defaults
are emitted wrapped in single quotes, `none` becomes literal `null`, and
other types pass through unquoted so objects/arrays/numbers/booleans
serialize correctly.

args.name: name
args.description: Signal name. Use a leading underscore (`_loading`, `_showForm`) for client-only state that should not round-trip to the server.

args.name: default
args.description: Initial value. String, number, boolean, `none`, or a JSON-like literal such as `{}` or `[]`. Defaults to the empty string.

name: show
summary: Hide the element until the Datastar expression becomes truthy. Emits `display:none` as an inline style so the element cannot flash into view before Datastar hydrates.
description:
Hide the element until the Datastar expression becomes truthy. Emits
`display:none` as an inline style so the element cannot flash into view
before Datastar hydrates.

args.name: expr
args.description: Datastar expression (references signals with `$name`).

name: toggle_class
summary: Reactively toggle a single CSS class based on a Datastar expression.
description: Reactively toggle a single CSS class based on a Datastar expression.

args.name: cls
args.description: Class name to add/remove.

args.name: expr
args.description: Datastar expression; class is present when truthy.

name: attr
summary: Reactively bind an HTML attribute's value to a Datastar expression.
description: Reactively bind an HTML attribute's value to a Datastar expression.

args.name: name
args.description: Attribute name (e.g. `selected`, `disabled`, `aria-pressed`).

args.name: expr
args.description: Datastar expression producing the attribute value.

name: live
summary: Subscribe the current element to a view's long-lived SSE stream on connect. The daemon pushes `datastar-patch-elements` frames that replace marked regions whenever the view's declared kernel events fire.
description:
Subscribe the current element to a view's long-lived SSE stream on
connect. The daemon pushes `datastar-patch-elements` frames that replace
marked regions whenever the view's declared kernel events fire.

args.name: view_name
args.description: View slug registered with the daemon. Resolves to `/api/runtime/view/<view_name>/sse`.

name: loading
summary: Mark the element as a Datastar action trigger whose in-flight state writes a boolean to the given signal. Pair with `spinner()` or `show()` to render a visual indicator.
description:
Mark the element as a Datastar action trigger whose in-flight state
writes a boolean to the given signal. Pair with `spinner()` or
`show()` to render a visual indicator.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Signal that will flip to `true` while the fetch is in flight. Conventionally underscore-prefixed (`_creating`).

name: spinner
summary: Render an inline spinner that is visible while the given signal is truthy. Designed to sit next to a button that uses `loading()` on the same signal.
description:
Render an inline spinner that is visible while the given signal is
truthy. Designed to sit next to a button that uses `loading()` on the
same signal.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Signal the spinner watches. Same value passed to `loading()`.

name: create
summary: Wire a click handler that POSTs a new item into a collection. The payload's `data` field is a Datastar expression — typically a form signal such as `$form`.
description:
Wire a click handler that POSTs a new item into a collection. The
payload's `data` field is a Datastar expression — typically a form
signal such as `$form`.

args.name: collection
args.description: Collection id (matches a schema in `.ship/collections/`).

args.name: data
args.description: Datastar expression whose value becomes the item's `data` payload.

name: update
summary: Wire a click handler that PUTs updated data onto a specific collection item.
description:
Wire a click handler that PUTs updated data onto a specific collection
item.

args.name: collection
args.description: Collection id.

args.name: id
args.description: Target item id.

args.name: data
args.description: Datastar expression for the new `data` payload.

name: delete
summary: Wire a click handler that DELETEs a specific collection item. Does not prompt — use `confirm_delete()` when a confirmation step is required.
description:
Wire a click handler that DELETEs a specific collection item. Does not
prompt — use `confirm_delete()` when a confirmation step is required.

args.name: collection
args.description: Collection id.

args.name: id
args.description: Item id to delete.

name: navigate
summary: Wire a click handler that fetches another view via Datastar `@get`, triggering an in-page morph. Use this for partial updates within the current view. For full shell-level routing use `nav()` or `view()`.
description:
Wire a click handler that fetches another view via Datastar `@get`,
triggering an in-page morph. Use this for partial updates within the
current view. For full shell-level routing use `nav()` or `view()`.

args.name: url
args.description: URL to GET (typically under `/api/runtime/view/...`).

name: nav
summary: Wire a click handler that navigates via the shell router when present, falling back to a full page load. Use this for shell-level navigation.
description:
Wire a click handler that navigates via the shell router when present,
falling back to a full page load. Use this for shell-level navigation.

args.name: path
args.description: Shell path to navigate to (e.g. `/agents`).

name: view
summary: Wire a click handler that navigates to a named view via the shell router when present, falling back to a full page load at `/<name>`.
description:
Wire a click handler that navigates to a named view via the shell router
when present, falling back to a full page load at `/<name>`.

args.name: name
args.description: View slug. Becomes the path `/<name>`.

name: on
summary: Generic event-listener binding. Use for ship-element custom events (`ship-change`, `ship-select`, etc.) and any DOM event not covered by the action-specific macros.
description:
Generic event-listener binding. Use for ship-element custom events
(`ship-change`, `ship-select`, etc.) and any DOM event not covered by
the action-specific macros.

args.name: event
args.description: Event name. Prefix is not required (no `on`).

args.name: expr
args.description: Datastar expression to run when the event fires. `evt` is in scope.

name: get
summary: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@get` to the given URL.
description: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@get` to the given URL.

args.name: url
args.description: Fully-qualified path to GET.

name: post
summary: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@post` to the given URL with the supplied payload expression.
description:
Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@post` to the given URL
with the supplied payload expression.

args.name: url
args.description: Target URL.

args.name: payload
args.description: Datastar expression (or JSON literal) passed as the request body. Defaults to an empty object.

name: put
summary: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@put`.
description: Wire a click handler that issues a Datastar `@put`.

args.name: url
args.description: Target URL.

args.name: payload
args.description: Request body expression. Defaults to an empty object.

name: put_on_change
summary: Wire a change-event handler (fires on every committed input change) that issues a Datastar `@put`. Good for settings inputs that persist on change without an explicit save button.
description:
Wire a change-event handler (fires on every committed input change)
that issues a Datastar `@put`. Good for settings inputs that persist
on change without an explicit save button.

args.name: url
args.description: Target URL.

args.name: payload
args.description: Request body expression. Defaults to an empty object.

name: submit
summary: Wire a form `submit` handler that POSTs the given payload.
description: Wire a form `submit` handler that POSTs the given payload.

args.name: url
args.description: Target URL.

args.name: payload
args.description: Request body expression. Defaults to an empty object.

name: bind
summary: Two-way-bind an input element's value to a Datastar signal.
description: Two-way-bind an input element's value to a Datastar signal.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Signal to bind. Dotted paths (`form.title`) are supported when the parent signal is an object.

name: create_job
summary: Wire a click handler that POSTs a new job to the runtime. The agent is passed as a Datastar expression so UI state (a select value, signal, etc.) can drive it. When `pipeline` is supplied it is added to the payload verbatim.
description:
Wire a click handler that POSTs a new job to the runtime. The agent is
passed as a Datastar expression so UI state (a select value, signal,
etc.) can drive it. When `pipeline` is supplied it is added to the
payload verbatim.

args.name: agent_expr
args.description: Datastar expression producing the agent slug (e.g. `$selectedAgent`).

args.name: pipeline
args.description: Optional pipeline name. When truthy it is inlined into the request body. Defaults to the empty string (omitted).

name: emit
summary: Wire a click handler that posts a kernel event via `/api/events/emit`. Use to trigger backend side-effects that other views listen to over SSE.
description:
Wire a click handler that posts a kernel event via `/api/events/emit`.
Use to trigger backend side-effects that other views listen to over SSE.

args.name: event_type
args.description: Kernel event type (e.g. `task.requested`).

args.name: data_expr
args.description: Datastar expression for the event's `data` payload. Defaults to an empty object.

name: feedback
summary: Wire a click handler that posts structured feedback to the active agent/session. The payload shape is whatever the agent designed — the receiving prompt reads it. Use this when an agent-authored view needs typed human input beyond free-text (ratings, selections, pick-one).
description:
Wire a click handler that posts structured feedback to the active
agent/session. The payload shape is whatever the agent designed — the
receiving prompt reads it. Use this when an agent-authored view needs
typed human input beyond free-text (ratings, selections, pick-one).

Emits as feedback (kind=action) so it flows through the
studio.feedback.created pipeline. The agent reads `payload` on the
event to see what the user picked.

args.name: payload_expr
args.description: Datastar/JS object expression that becomes the feedback `payload`.

name: tab
summary: Wire a tab button. Sets the named signal to `value` on click and exposes `aria-selected` reactively so CSS can style the active tab.
description:
Wire a tab button. Sets the named signal to `value` on click and
exposes `aria-selected` reactively so CSS can style the active tab.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Signal that tracks the active tab value.

args.name: value
args.description: The string value this tab represents.

args.name: label
args.description: Accepted for call-site readability; currently unused by the emitted attributes. Defaults to the empty string.

name: tab_panel
summary: Show the tab panel only when the tab signal matches `value`. Uses `display:none` as a base style so panels don't flash before Datastar hydrates.
description:
Show the tab panel only when the tab signal matches `value`. Uses
`display:none` as a base style so panels don't flash before Datastar
hydrates.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: The same signal used with `tab()`.

args.name: value
args.description: The value this panel is visible for.

name: chip
summary: Wire a filter chip: on click, sets the named signal to `value` and (optionally) refreshes the view's SSE stream so the server reruns the query with the new filter. Also exposes `selected` reactively for the active chip.
description:
Wire a filter chip: on click, sets the named signal to `value` and
(optionally) refreshes the view's SSE stream so the server reruns the
query with the new filter. Also exposes `selected` reactively for the
active chip.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Filter signal.

args.name: value
args.description: Value this chip selects.

args.name: view_name
args.description: When set, a `@get('/api/runtime/view/<view_name>/sse')` is appended to refresh results. Defaults to the empty string (client-only filter).

name: chip_all
summary: A companion to `chip()` that clears the filter (sets the signal to the empty string) and optionally refreshes SSE. Use for an "All" chip next to value-specific chips.
description:
A companion to `chip()` that clears the filter (sets the signal to the
empty string) and optionally refreshes SSE. Use for an "All" chip next
to value-specific chips.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Filter signal to clear.

args.name: view_name
args.description: When set, refreshes `/api/runtime/view/<view_name>/sse` after clearing.

name: search
summary: Wire a debounced search input: two-way-binds to a signal and refreshes the view's SSE stream when the user pauses typing.
description:
Wire a debounced search input: two-way-binds to a signal and refreshes
the view's SSE stream when the user pauses typing.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Query signal (bound with `data-bind`).

args.name: view_name
args.description: View whose SSE stream to refresh on input.

args.name: delay
args.description: Datastar debounce modifier (e.g. `300ms`, `500ms`). Defaults to `300ms`.

name: on_change_debounced
summary: Run an expression on `change`, debounced. Useful for settings that auto-save after the user finishes editing.
description:
Run an expression on `change`, debounced. Useful for settings that
auto-save after the user finishes editing.

args.name: expr
args.description: Datastar expression.

args.name: delay
args.description: Debounce duration. Defaults to `300ms`.

name: radio
summary: Wire a radio-style button: sets the named signal to `value` on click and reflects the selection via `aria-checked`.
description:
Wire a radio-style button: sets the named signal to `value` on click
and reflects the selection via `aria-checked`.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Selection signal.

args.name: value
args.description: Value this option represents.

name: confirm_delete
summary: Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with "Delete this item?" and, on OK, DELETEs the item. For a typed Ship-styled confirm dialog use `confirm_dialog()` / `confirm_trigger()`.
description:
Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with
"Delete this item?" and, on OK, DELETEs the item. For a typed
Ship-styled confirm dialog use `confirm_dialog()` / `confirm_trigger()`.

args.name: collection
args.description: Collection id.

args.name: id
args.description: Item id to delete.

name: confirm
summary: Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with the given message and, on OK, runs the Datastar expression.
description:
Wire a click handler that shows a browser `confirm()` dialog with the
given message and, on OK, runs the Datastar expression.

args.name: message
args.description: Dialog text.

args.name: action_expr
args.description: Datastar expression to run when the user confirms.

name: live_persistent
summary: Like `live()`, but configures Datastar with `requestCancellation: 'disabled'` so the SSE connection is not aborted when other `@get`/`@post` actions fire on the page. Use for views that must stay subscribed across navigations within the same shell region.
description:
Like `live()`, but configures Datastar with `requestCancellation: 'disabled'`
so the SSE connection is not aborted when other `@get`/`@post` actions
fire on the page. Use for views that must stay subscribed across
navigations within the same shell region.

args.name: view_name
args.description: View slug whose SSE stream to subscribe to.

name: on_fetch_error
summary: Bind a signal to receive a failure message when a fetch action on THIS element returns an HTTP error or non-SSE body.
description:
Bind a signal to receive a failure message when a fetch action on
THIS element returns an HTTP error or non-SSE body.

Datastar fires a `datastar-fetch` event on document with
  detail: { type: 'error', el: <trigger>, argsRaw: { status } }
when `onopen` sees a >= 400 response. This macro attaches a
document-level listener scoped to the current element so a failed
`@post`/`@get`/`@put`/`@delete` patches the named error signal.

args.name: signal_name
args.description: Signal that receives the error message when the fetch fails.

args.name: message
args.description: JS expression producing the error message. Has access to `evt.detail.argsRaw.status`. Defaults to `'HTTP ' + status`.

name: form
summary: Auto-generate a form from a collection schema. Emits one labelled input per field, with the input type chosen from the field definition: `enum` -> `<ship-select>`, `boolean` -> `<ship-switch>`, `number` -> numeric `<ship-input>`, `markdown` -> `<ship-textarea>`, everything else -> `<ship-input>`. Required fields get a red asterisk. Each input is two-way-bound under `form_signal.<field>`.
description:
Auto-generate a form from a collection schema. Emits one labelled
input per field, with the input type chosen from the field definition:
`enum` -> `<ship-select>`, `boolean` -> `<ship-switch>`, `number` ->
numeric `<ship-input>`, `markdown` -> `<ship-textarea>`, everything
else -> `<ship-input>`. Required fields get a red asterisk. Each input
is two-way-bound under `form_signal.<field>`.

args.name: schema
args.description: Collection schema dict (from `ship_schema(collection)`).

args.name: collection
args.description: Collection id. Currently accepted for parity with related macros; not used by the emitted HTML.

args.name: form_signal
args.description: Parent signal object inputs bind into. Defaults to `form`.

name: table
summary: Auto-generate a data table from a schema plus a list of items. Emits an ID column, one column per schema field with type-appropriate formatting (enum -> chip, boolean -> badge, number -> monospace, array -> up-to-4 chips with overflow badge), an Updated column, and a per-row delete button wired with `delete(collection, item.id)`.
description:
Auto-generate a data table from a schema plus a list of items. Emits
an ID column, one column per schema field with type-appropriate
formatting (enum -> chip, boolean -> badge, number -> monospace,
array -> up-to-4 chips with overflow badge), an Updated column, and a
per-row delete button wired with `delete(collection, item.id)`.

args.name: schema
args.description: Collection schema dict.

args.name: items
args.description: Iterable of item records with `.id`, `.data`, `.updated_at`.

args.name: collection
args.description: Collection id (used by the per-row delete button).

name: layout_center
summary: Open a centered single-column layout wrapper: `max-width` with horizontal auto-margins and generous vertical padding (space-6 top, space-12 bottom). Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for settings pages, forms, and detail views.
description:
Open a centered single-column layout wrapper: `max-width` with
horizontal auto-margins and generous vertical padding (space-6 top,
space-12 bottom). Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for
settings pages, forms, and detail views.

args.name: max_width
args.description: CSS length for the column's maximum width. Defaults to `768px`.

name: layout_sidebar
summary: Open a two-column grid: fixed sidebar + flexible main pane, full height. Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for explorers and canvas-style views.
description:
Open a two-column grid: fixed sidebar + flexible main pane, full
height. Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for explorers and
canvas-style views.

args.name: sidebar_width
args.description: CSS length for the sidebar column. Defaults to `240px`.

name: layout_three_col
summary: Open a three-column grid: fixed left sidebar + flexible main pane + fixed right info panel, full height. Must be closed with `layout_end()`. Good for IDE-style views.
description:
Open a three-column grid: fixed left sidebar + flexible main pane +
fixed right info panel, full height. Must be closed with
`layout_end()`. Good for IDE-style views.

args.name: left
args.description: CSS length for the left column. Defaults to `240px`.

args.name: right
args.description: CSS length for the right column. Defaults to `320px`.

name: layout_end
summary: Close a layout wrapper opened by `layout_center()`, `layout_sidebar()`, or `layout_three_col()`.
description:
Close a layout wrapper opened by `layout_center()`, `layout_sidebar()`,
or `layout_three_col()`.

name: toast_container
summary: Mount the `<ship-toast-container>` in the bottom-right corner with the id `ship-toasts`. `toast_action()` looks this up by id to dispatch toasts. Place once per page.
description:
Mount the `<ship-toast-container>` in the bottom-right corner with the
id `ship-toasts`. `toast_action()` looks this up by id to dispatch
toasts. Place once per page.

name: toast_action
summary: Wire a click handler that dispatches a toast through the container mounted by `toast_container()`.
description:
Wire a click handler that dispatches a toast through the container
mounted by `toast_container()`.

args.name: message
args.description: Toast title text.

args.name: tone
args.description: Visual tone — `default`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`. Defaults to `default`.

args.name: duration
args.description: Time in milliseconds before auto-dismiss. Defaults to `3000`.

name: confirm_dialog
summary: Render a `<ship-alert-dialog>` that gates a destructive action. Cancel closes the dialog; Confirm executes `action_attrs` and then closes. Pair with `confirm_trigger(id)` on the opening button.
description:
Render a `<ship-alert-dialog>` that gates a destructive action.
Cancel closes the dialog; Confirm executes `action_attrs` and then
closes. Pair with `confirm_trigger(id)` on the opening button.

args.name: id
args.description: Unique id suffix. The dialog's DOM id becomes `confirm-<id>`.

args.name: title
args.description: Heading text.

args.name: description
args.description: Body text under the heading.

args.name: action_attrs
args.description: Pre-rendered attributes for the confirm button — typically a `delete()` / `post()` / `put()` macro call.

name: confirm_trigger
summary: Wire a click handler that opens a `confirm_dialog()` by id (adds the `open` attribute to `confirm-<id>`).
description:
Wire a click handler that opens a `confirm_dialog()` by id (adds the
`open` attribute to `confirm-<id>`).

args.name: id
args.description: Matching id passed to `confirm_dialog()`.

name: section
summary: Open a `<ship-card>` with a standardized slot-header row: optional leading ship-icon + title on the left, optional trailing link pill (muted text + right-chevron) on the right. Must be paired with `endsection()`.
description:
Open a `<ship-card>` with a standardized slot-header row: optional
leading ship-icon + title on the left, optional trailing link pill
(muted text + right-chevron) on the right. Must be paired with
`endsection()`.

When `link_href` starts with `/api/runtime/view/`, the trailing link
is wired to `@get(link_href)` with `.prevent` so SSE-aware navigation
takes over. Otherwise it is a plain anchor.

The layout is inline-styled on purpose — the macro owns the
standardized design tokens so view authors don't have to re-declare
`.dash-section-head`.

args.name: title
args.description: Section heading text. Required.

args.name: icon
args.description: ship-icon registry name (e.g. `activity`, `cpu`). Optional.

args.name: link_href
args.description: URL for the trailing pill. Optional.

args.name: link_label
args.description: Visible text on the trailing pill. Optional.

name: endsection
summary: Close the `<ship-card>` opened by `section()`.
description: Close the `<ship-card>` opened by `section()`.

name: styles
summary: Emit the shared `<style>` block used by `form()` and `table()`: `.ship-form-field`, `.ship-form-label`, `.ship-table`, `.mono`, `.muted`, `.null`. Place once in `<head>` when a view renders an auto-form or auto-table.
description:
Emit the shared `<style>` block used by `form()` and `table()`:
`.ship-form-field`, `.ship-form-label`, `.ship-table`, `.mono`,
`.muted`, `.null`. Place once in `<head>` when a view renders an
auto-form or auto-table.
